sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Shiv Kumar Yadav,Rajesh Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Shiv Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Manish Kumar Pandey,
learned AGA-I for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 41 of 2023, under Sections 366, 376 IPC, Police Station Badosarai, District Barabanki.
3. This case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 10.02.2023 alleging that the applicant had enticed away the informant' daughter aged about 20 years in the night of 07.02.2023.
In the statement of the victim recorded under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she stated that she is major, she used to talk to the applicant for the past four years and she loves him.
Her family members had settled her marriage with some other person, the marriage was scheduled to take place on 22.02.2023; that she did not want to marry that other person.

4. In her statement recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C. also, she stated that she had gone away from her home out of her own free will because she did not want to marry a person selected by her family Shanoo Shukla vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17346022/
1 members.
5. In the medico legal examination report of the victim no injury has been reported on any part of her body.

entities.text: Shanoo Shukla vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstance of the case and keeping in view that the victim is major, she loves the applicant and she has stated that she had gone with him out of her own free will because her family members wanted to get her married to other person, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
7. Accordingly, this bail application is allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Order Date :- 21.4.2023 Pradeep/-
